name: context-pane
description: Live bars just above the prompt: your month, week and 5-hour session usage, how full the context window is with recall zones (SHARP, GOOD, WEAKER, FORGETFUL, AUTO-COMPACT), and a prompt cache countdown with Keep warm. Switch each bar on or off.

showMonth.title: Month bar
showMonth.description: A 1px line for a monthly usage window, when one is reported.

showWeek.title: Week bar
showWeek.description: A 1px line for the 7-day usage window.

showSession.title: 5h Session bar
showSession.description: The 5-hour usage window, with when it resets.

showContext.title: Context bar
showContext.description: How full the context window is, with recall zones.

showCache.title: Cache bar
showCache.description: The prompt cache countdown, with Keep warm.
